users.getSpaceUsage.title: Read used and allocated Dropbox space
users.getSpaceUsage.description: Read used and allocated Dropbox space for the authenticated account.

users.getAccount.title: Read a Dropbox user account by account id
users.getAccount.description: Read a Dropbox user account by account id. The caller must be permitted to view that account.

sharing.listFolders.title: List shared folders the account can access

account.delete_profile_photo.title: Deletes the current user's profile photo.
account.delete_profile_photo.description: Deletes the current user's profile photo. Requires scope account_info.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/account/delete_profile_photo.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

account.set_profile_photo.title: Sets a user's profile photo.
account.set_profile_photo.description: Sets a user's profile photo. Requires scope account_info.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/account/set_profile_photo.

photo.description: Image to set as the user's new profile photo.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

auth.token.revoke.title: Disables the access token used to authenticate the call.
auth.token.revoke.description: Disables the access token used to authenticate the call. If there is a corresponding refresh token for the access token, this disables that refresh token, as well as any other access tokens for that refresh token. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/auth/token/revoke.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

check.user.title: This endpoint performs User Authentication, validating the supplied access token, and returns the supplied string, to allow you to test y...
check.user.description: This endpoint performs User Authentication, validating the supplied access token, and returns the supplied string, to allow you to test your code and connection to the Dropbox API. It has no other effect. If you receive an HTTP 200 response with the supplied query, it indicates at least part of the Dropbox API infrastructure is working and that the access token is valid. Preview endpoint; Dropbox may change it without notice. Requires scope account_info.read. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/check/user.

query.description: The string that you'd like to be echoed back to you.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

contacts.delete_manual_contacts.title: Removes all manually added contacts.
contacts.delete_manual_contacts.description: Removes all manually added contacts. You'll still keep contacts who are on your team or who you imported. New contacts will be added when you share. Requires scope contacts.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/contacts/delete_manual_contacts.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

contacts.delete_manual_contacts_batch.title: Removes manually added contacts from the given list.
contacts.delete_manual_contacts_batch.description: Removes manually added contacts from the given list. Requires scope contacts.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/contacts/delete_manual_contacts_batch.

email_addresses.description: List of manually added contacts to be deleted.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_properties.properties.add.title: Add property groups to a Dropbox file.
file_properties.properties.add.description: Add property groups to a Dropbox file. See templates/add_for_user or templates/add_for_team to create new templates. Requires scope files.metadata.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_properties/properties/add.

path.description: A unique identifier for the file or folder.

property_groups.description: The property groups which are to be added to a Dropbox file. No two groups in the input should refer to the same template.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_properties.properties.overwrite.title: Overwrite property groups associated with a file.
file_properties.properties.overwrite.description: Overwrite property groups associated with a file. This endpoint should be used instead of properties/update when property groups are being updated via a "snapshot" instead of via a "delta". In other words, this endpoint will delete all omitted fields from a property group, whereas properties/update will only delete fields that are explicitly marked for deletion. Requires scope files.metadata.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_properties/properties/overwrite.

path.description: A unique identifier for the file or folder.

property_groups.description: The property groups "snapshot" updates to force apply. No two groups in the input should refer to the same template.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_properties.properties.remove.title: Permanently removes the specified property group from the file.
file_properties.properties.remove.description: Permanently removes the specified property group from the file. To remove specific property field key value pairs, see properties/update. To update a template, see templates/update_for_user or templates/update_for_team. To remove a template, see templates/remove_for_user or templates/remove_for_team. Requires scope files.metadata.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_properties/properties/remove.

path.description: A unique identifier for the file or folder.

property_template_ids.description: A list of identifiers for a template created by templates/add_for_user or templates/add_for_team.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_properties.properties.search.title: Search across property templates for particular property field values.
file_properties.properties.search.description: Search across property templates for particular property field values. Requires scope files.metadata.read. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_properties/properties/search.

template_filter.description: Filter results to contain only properties associated with these template IDs.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_properties.properties.search.contin.title: Once a cursor has been retrieved from properties/search, use this to paginate through all search results.
file_properties.properties.search.contin.description: Once a cursor has been retrieved from properties/search, use this to paginate through all search results. Requires scope files.metadata.read. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_properties/properties/search/continue.

cursor.description: The cursor returned by your last call to properties/search or properties/search/continue.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_properties.properties.update.title: Add, update or remove properties associated with the supplied file and templates.
file_properties.properties.update.description: Add, update or remove properties associated with the supplied file and templates. This endpoint should be used instead of properties/overwrite when property groups are being updated via a "delta" instead of via a "snapshot" . In other words, this endpoint will not delete any omitted fields from a property group, whereas properties/overwrite will delete any fields that are omitted from a property group. Requires scope files.metadata.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_properties/properties/update.

path.description: A unique identifier for the file or folder.

update_property_groups.description: The property groups "delta" updates to apply.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_properties.templates.add_for_team.title: Add a template associated with a team.
file_properties.templates.add_for_team.description: Add a template associated with a team. See properties/add to add properties to a file or folder. Note: this endpoint will create team-owned templates. Requires scope files.team_metadata.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_properties/templates/add_for_team.

name.description: Display name for the template. Template names can be up to 256 bytes.

description.description: Description for the template. Template descriptions can be up to 1024 bytes.

fields.description: Definitions of the property fields associated with this template. There can be up to 32 properties in a single template.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_properties.templates.add_for_user.title: Add a template associated with a user.
file_properties.templates.add_for_user.description: Add a template associated with a user. See properties/add to add properties to a file. This endpoint can't be called on a team member or admin's behalf. Requires scope files.metadata.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_properties/templates/add_for_user.

name.description: Display name for the template. Template names can be up to 256 bytes.

description.description: Description for the template. Template descriptions can be up to 1024 bytes.

fields.description: Definitions of the property fields associated with this template. There can be up to 32 properties in a single template.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_properties.templates.get_for_team.title: Get the schema for a specified template.
file_properties.templates.get_for_team.description: Get the schema for a specified template. Requires scope files.team_metadata.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_properties/templates/get_for_team.

template_id.description: An identifier for template added by route See templates/add_for_user or templates/add_for_team.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_properties.templates.get_for_user.title: Get the schema for a specified template.
file_properties.templates.get_for_user.description: Get the schema for a specified template. This endpoint can't be called on a team member or admin's behalf. Requires scope files.metadata.read. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_properties/templates/get_for_user.

template_id.description: An identifier for template added by route See templates/add_for_user or templates/add_for_team.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_properties.templates.list_for_team.title: Get the template identifiers for a team.
file_properties.templates.list_for_team.description: Get the template identifiers for a team. To get the schema of each template use templates/get_for_team. Requires scope files.team_metadata.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_properties/templates/list_for_team.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_properties.templates.list_for_user.title: Get the template identifiers for a team.
file_properties.templates.list_for_user.description: Get the template identifiers for a team. To get the schema of each template use templates/get_for_user. This endpoint can't be called on a team member or admin's behalf. Requires scope files.metadata.read. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_properties/templates/list_for_user.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_properties.templates.remove_for_tea.title: Permanently removes the specified template created from templates/add_for_user.
file_properties.templates.remove_for_tea.description: Permanently removes the specified template created from templates/add_for_user. All properties associated with the template will also be removed. This action cannot be undone. Requires scope files.team_metadata.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_properties/templates/remove_for_team.

template_id.description: An identifier for a template created by templates/add_for_user or templates/add_for_team.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_properties.templates.remove_for_use.title: Permanently removes the specified template created from templates/add_for_user.
file_properties.templates.remove_for_use.description: Permanently removes the specified template created from templates/add_for_user. All properties associated with the template will also be removed. This action cannot be undone. Requires scope files.metadata.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_properties/templates/remove_for_user.

template_id.description: An identifier for a template created by templates/add_for_user or templates/add_for_team.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_properties.templates.update_for_tea.title: Update a template associated with a team.
file_properties.templates.update_for_tea.description: Update a template associated with a team. This route can update the template name, the template description and add optional properties to templates. Requires scope files.team_metadata.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_properties/templates/update_for_team.

template_id.description: An identifier for template added by See templates/add_for_user or templates/add_for_team.

name.description: A display name for the template. template names can be up to 256 bytes.

description.description: Description for the new template. Template descriptions can be up to 1024 bytes.

add_fields.description: Property field templates to be added to the group template. There can be up to 32 properties in a single template.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_properties.templates.update_for_use.title: Update a template associated with a user.
file_properties.templates.update_for_use.description: Update a template associated with a user. This route can update the template name, the template description and add optional properties to templates. This endpoint can't be called on a team member or admin's behalf. Requires scope files.metadata.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_properties/templates/update_for_user.

template_id.description: An identifier for template added by See templates/add_for_user or templates/add_for_team.

name.description: A display name for the template. template names can be up to 256 bytes.

description.description: Description for the new template. Template descriptions can be up to 1024 bytes.

add_fields.description: Property field templates to be added to the group template. There can be up to 32 properties in a single template.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_requests.count.title: Returns the total number of file requests owned by this user.
file_requests.count.description: Returns the total number of file requests owned by this user. Includes both open and closed file requests. Requires scope file_requests.read. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_requests/count.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_requests.create.title: Creates a file request for this user.
file_requests.create.description: Creates a file request for this user. Requires scope file_requests.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_requests/create.

title.description: The title of the file request. Must not be empty.

destination.description: The path of the folder in the Dropbox where uploaded files will be sent. For apps with the app folder permission, this will be relative to the app folder.

deadline.description: The deadline for the file request. Deadlines can only be set by Professional and Business accounts.

open.description: Whether or not the file request should be open. If the file request is closed, it will not accept any file submissions, but it can be opened later.

description.description: A description of the file request.

video_project_id.description: If this request was created from video project, its id.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_requests.delete.title: Delete a batch of closed file requests.
file_requests.delete.description: Delete a batch of closed file requests. Requires scope file_requests.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_requests/delete.

ids.description: List IDs of the file requests to delete.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_requests.delete_all_closed.title: Delete all closed file requests owned by this user.
file_requests.delete_all_closed.description: Delete all closed file requests owned by this user. Requires scope file_requests.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_requests/delete_all_closed.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_requests.get.title: Returns the specified file request.
file_requests.get.description: Returns the specified file request. Requires scope file_requests.read. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_requests/get.

id.description: The ID of the file request to retrieve.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_requests.list.title: Returns a list of file requests owned by this user.
file_requests.list.description: Returns a list of file requests owned by this user. For apps with the app folder permission, this will only return file requests with destinations in the app folder. Requires scope file_requests.read. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_requests/list.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_requests.list.continue.title: Once a cursor has been retrieved from list:2, use this to paginate through all file requests.
file_requests.list.continue.description: Once a cursor has been retrieved from list:2, use this to paginate through all file requests. cursor.description: The cursor returned by the previous API call specified in the endpoint description.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_requests.list_v2.title: Returns a list of file requests owned by this user.
file_requests.list_v2.description: Returns a list of file requests owned by this user. For apps with the app folder permission, this will only return file requests with destinations in the app folder. Requires scope file_requests.read. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_requests/list_v2.

limit.description: The maximum number of file requests that should be returned per request.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

file_requests.update.title: Update a file request.
file_requests.update.description: Update a file request. Requires scope file_requests.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/file_requests/update.

id.description: The ID of the file request to update.

title.description: The new title of the file request. Must not be empty.

destination.description: The new path of the folder in the Dropbox where uploaded files will be sent. For apps with the app folder permission, this will be relative to the app folder.

deadline.description: The new deadline for the file request. Deadlines can only be set by Professional and Business accounts.

open.description: Whether to set this file request as open or closed.

description.description: The description of the file request.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

files.alpha.get_metadata.title: Returns the metadata for a file or folder.
files.alpha.get_metadata.description: Returns the metadata for a file or folder. This is an alpha endpoint compatible with the properties API. Note: Metadata for the root folder is unsupported. Deprecated by Dropbox. Preview endpoint; Dropbox may change it without notice. Requires scope files.metadata.read. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/files/alpha/get_metadata.

path.description: The path of a file or folder on Dropbox.

include_media_info.description: If true, FileMetadata.media_info is set for photo and video.

include_deleted.description: If true, DeletedMetadata will be returned for deleted file or folder, otherwise LookupError.not_found will be returned.

include_has_explicit_shared_members.description: If true, the results will include a flag for each file indicating whether or not that file has any explicit members.

include_property_groups.description: If set to a valid list of template IDs, FileMetadata.property_groups is set if there exists property data associated with the file and each of the listed templates.

include_property_templates.description: If set to a valid list of template IDs, FileMetadata.property_groups is set for files with custom properties.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

files.copy_batch.title: Copy multiple files or folders to different locations at once in the user's Dropbox.
files.copy_batch.description: Copy multiple files or folders to different locations at once in the user's Dropbox. This route will return job ID immediately and do the async copy job in background. Please use copy_batch/check to check the job status. Deprecated by Dropbox. Requires scope files.content.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/files/copy_batch.

entries.description: List of entries to be moved or copied. Each entry is RelocationPath.

autorename.description: If there's a conflict with any file, have the Dropbox server try to autorename that file to avoid the conflict.

allow_ownership_transfer.description: Allow moves by owner even if it would result in an ownership transfer for the content being moved. This does not apply to copies.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

files.copy_batch.check.title: Returns the status of an asynchronous job for copy_batch:1.
files.copy_batch.check.description: Returns the status of an asynchronous job for copy_batch:1. If success, it returns list of results for each entry. Deprecated by Dropbox. Requires scope files.content.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/files/copy_batch/check.

async_job_id.description: Id of the asynchronous job. This is the value of a response returned from the method that launched the job.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

files.copy_batch.check_v2.title: Returns the status of an asynchronous job for copy_batch:2.
files.copy_batch.check_v2.description: Returns the status of an asynchronous job for copy_batch:2. It returns list of results for each entry. Requires scope files.content.write. HTTP POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/files/copy_batch/check_v2.

async_job_id.description: Id of the asynchronous job. This is the value of a response returned from the method that launched the job.

data.description: Official Dropbox JSON response. Null when the route result is Void.

files.copy_batch_v2.title: Copy multiple files or folders to different locations at once in the user's Dropbox.
files.copy_batch_v2.description: Copy multiple files or folders to different locations at once in the user's Dropbox. This route will replace copy_batch. The main difference is this route will return status for each entry, while copy_batch raises failure if any entry fails.
